text: This is the WORST buffet I have ever been to. The food was either spoiled, overcooked, burnt, and tasteless. I WON'T be returning. The staff was ok.

Father's Day dinner (2019):

They forgot to include the shrimp in the shrimp pasta that my dad ordered.

The fried calamari is subpar and the marinara sauce was a little salty.  Definitely had better before...although the positive was that the marinara sauce was warm.

47. Rigatoni Con Salsicee - was pretty good.  The pasta was al dente, the sauce was warm and the portion size was great.

Complimentary bruschetta - bread was nicely toasted with fresh tomatoes on top

Complimentary bread - nothing that stands out or even mentioning

Server asked if we wanted any parmesan cheese, we said yes, but he never came back with the cheese and we were already half way through our meal.

Would I come back? Still undecided.
Many vegan options! I got the pepperoni and it was great. The staff was so friendly even though there was a bit of a wait for the pizza.

Cheesesteak w/ provolone: 93/100 Very, very good. However, I didn't get much smoked flavor from this.

Red neck egg roll: 4.5/5 I enjoyed this a lot. Pulled pork is good but what really makes this work is how the cole slaw adds a different texture.

Candied bacon: 5/5 must have

Corn bread: 3/5 dry

Love the original wings. Everybody else makes them but Hooters is just the best. And no men 
don't like  lookin at the tits.

The gyro here is excellent.  I intentionally go to the Sparks Costco when I want a gyro!  The food quality and cost is excellent and I have enjoyed every visit!  Will keep on coming to support a small business and a yummy restaurant.

Really tasty meatballs, nice sear on the outside, not too tightly packed, clearly hand formed.  Nice wine list, nice bar space.  Bartender however, I vote most likely to shoot up a high school.  That surly, uninspired and providing crappy service - bartender kinda turned himself around after a few f-bombs but still, fairly unprofessional.  11/19, PM bar.

The staff here stinks.  No customer service, they took the order wrong (again) and refused to fix it even though it was paid for.  We will never be going back to this Jimmy John's.  They need to have a customer service class, not that I think it would help.  These people are hopeless.  We will take our business elsewhere even if we have to drive farther away.

Love, love, love this place. The croissants are so light and flaky, They melt in your mouth.  The macarons are delicate with full flavor. All of the pastries have been wonderful. The staff has always been very nice.
Extremely busy, staff seemed overwhelmed and was sent from host stand to bar to host stand to server to place my order to go as wait was about an hour for dine in.

I ordered a 12 piece nuggets for my son and when I got home only 10 smalls little tasty nuggets. I was beyond disappointed but not willing to go back. And these guys are so small that I should be having extra not less.

A great variety of menu items, certainly something for everyone, and it's all delicious!
I was raised in mid-city, and now live in Bywater, and Katie's embodies the tradition of great, neighborhood friendly restaurants in New Orleans. I always recommend Katie's to out of towners!

This is casual dining joint adjacent to the university.  When I visited they had just started a modified reopening due to Covid.   They did not disappoint. The staff are friendly and attentive and the food was great.   Top-notch pizza; exceptional crust.   Everything was fresh.  Next time in Boise I will return.

My son's birthday party was yesterday, May 5th. When we arrived, we were not greeted for about 10 minutes. I sat there holding a cake and other items in my arms and no one said a word. Eventually, another customer let me know the computers were down. Which would have been fine, if someone had let me know so I wasn't standing there for no reason. My guests were asked to leave on four different occasions, even though they were part of the party and then unlimited jumping because of cinco de mayo. I was told over the phone this, and that is why I chose the birthday party time I did. I also confirmed THREE times with my party host and it was confirmed by her. My guests drove an hour and a half to come to this location, just to be treated rudely and asked to leave. Some of the workers were so rude and acted as if they were doing us a favor by being there. Naomi being one of them. I spoke with the manager of the location, two times, and was told I would be receiving an email from her in a few moments to make things right. I have still not received an email from her.

I don't recommend this for a child's birthday, at all.
Great restaurant/ deli. Family owned and operated.  The meatballs were some of the best that I have ever tasted. The eggplant and sauce was delicious.  A definite must when in New Hope.
Came into for lunch with a couple friends!!! Had the new chicken pot pie! It was delicious! And our server Evan was as fantastic!!!
Tried to grab breakfast on the way to work at 4:40 a and they are closed. Site says they open at 4a. Looks like no breakfast for this guy today. Need to update your business times please.

Everything was superb! The service was impeccable, food divine...A+ start to finish! Their portions are generous and over the top.  The Oyster Rockefeller were probably the best I've ever had. Rich, but light - truly scrumptious. The lobster bisque, delicious but very rich - we split the soup and it was more than enough for 2.  I had the NY strip - perfectly cooked medium rare.  My guest had the filet mignon & alaskan king crab - she said it was sublime. She ordered cocktails while I ordered a 1/2 bottle of cabernet.  Great drink options & wine list. It was her birthday so they brought out a baked Alaska at the end! It was so fun - the flames & the grandeur of it. I had coffee afterwards - it came with a fun over the top set up!  And to top it off, they sent us on our way with a small cake that was delicious with coffee the next morning!  Timothy, our waiter, and the young man who helped him throughout the evening (I so wish I could remember his name to give him a shout out) - were exceptional!!  It was truly a dining experience to rival anything I've experienced in SF, Las Vegas or NYC. If you're looking for a truly exceptional dining experience, you can't go wrong here.
Excellent food. Carnitas were great! Seafood enchiladas were great! They have Coke Zero! Nice upscale atmosphere!

I go here way too much with my sister but can't get enough of their food, wine and atmosphere. Get. The. Pumpkin. Gnocchi. The best things are the oysters, pumpkin gnocchi and mushroom risotto. Great wine selection and good desserts. Make a reservation, it gets busy quickly.

Stereotypical breakfast/lunch diner.  Bright colors sunny decor with chirpy servers.  The outstanding feature that differentiates it my opinion is the serving of mimosas for $2 on weekend.  The sodium levels in the food prevents a higher rating.  Please listen sodium kills!
Ordered our meals through DoorDash and I am absolutely satisfied with our meals. Thank you whoever did the cooking tonight!

i had only been to this place once before and it the food was good. the second time i went it was the last day of school and my mom was taking me to lunch. well she went to the bathroom and i asked for a table and she refused me and told me to wait for my mother in the car. i was offended. i left immediately and drove (in my own car) to the far superior jimmy johns.
Food is very good!  Very tasty and wish there was a spot closer to King of Prussia.  Staff friendliness could improve but overall worth going.  You will love the food.

I was looking for some good fried rice and found them on the Yelp app based on who was open late. I ordered a combination of chicken with shrimp fried rice. 

I didn't think to ask for soy sauce as I assumed it would be included automatically but despite that, the rice was ready in about 10 minutes. The shrimp were small almost like salad shrimp and not what I was expecting but the pieces of chicken were big so I enjoyed the fried rice.

We LOVE Eddie & Sam's!  When they say NY Pizza, they are not kidding!
The slices are huge and they definitely taste like New York pizza (I'm from Brooklyn and have eaten my fair share of NY pizza).
The lasagna and chicken parm. are a favorite in my house, but I also really love the cheese pizza.  They also have an awesome gluten free crust!
If you like 90% bread and 10 % toppings, you should love panera's sandwich's. Personally I like a whole lot more filling, but that's just me ‍.

Finally got to check this place out! There is plenty of parking. We split the spinach artichoke dip as an appetizer. You can never go wrong with spinach artichoke dip. I had the Electric raspberry lemonade mixed drink which was fantastic. It was light and refreshing. I'm not a huge fan of pineapple juice but it was just a hint so I had another! I had the Greek salad for dinner which was plenty of food! The dressing was packed with flavor. I only needed 1/2 of the dressing it came with. Thankfully it came on the side. There is a great view and outside seating. Unfortunately it had thunderstormed all day so the outside bar was closed due to weather. Our waiter was friendly, knowledgeable about the menu and attentive. It is a little pricey but you get what you pay for. I will definitely be back!

Tried this restaurant for the first time and loved it! It is only a few weeks old but the decor is cute and the atmosphere is great with their Latin music. We had the empanada and tamale for appetizer and it was absolutely delicious. Our mains were the ropa vieja and the ahi de gallina which were both equally delicious and plentiful. Flavors were great and portions were generous and presentation was lovely. The pricing is also very reasonable! It's fun to have something so authentic in the central west end area! Will definitely be back!

Definitely will be back! Stopped in yesterday evening for some take out. Was actually craving fish tacos and they were perfect! I got the meal which came with tasty fresh refried beans and Mexican rice. My love got the carnitas burrito meal which came with refried beans and a side salad. This place is authentic and welcoming. I plan on visiting frequently. The only negative for me is location. I traveled  15 minutes each way, but it was worth it!

Great Indian food! Came in here because I was craving Indian food, and it fulfilled that crave and more. The chicken tikka masala was pure comfort food, and the parotta was really tasty to dip in the sauce. Everyone I was with liked their food as well and the service was good! Waiter came to check in with how we were doing, but not too often at the same time.
Love everything I've ever ordered here. Make sure you go with someone you like to chat with because real Italian pizza and Stromboli's take time to produce. This is not fast food. It is delicious.
Nice place to have a birthday, event, or fun with kids and family. Special effects with lighting make it an eventful place. Nice bar. Nice kitchen. Nice arcade. Great place to bowl.
Very nice spot. Classy atmosphere and delicious food. The lamb empanadas were  mmmm mmm

I thought the food was great. Definitely a place for foodies.  I understand they have a large late night crowd and that probably explains why I thought the interior was a little murky and needed a facelift.  
But if you're talking strict food and wait staff definitely solid.  We will definitely return.

Solid Chinese food.  Was in the area and craving egg foo yung.  My fave egg foo yung is at Chef Li in Oldsmar, but this was convenient so I ordered it, and it was delicious.  Shrimp egg rolls were addictingly delicious.  Really liked the krab sticks as well...the dipping sauce was addicting.  I'll be back here for sure.  Really enjoyed this food.

I ordered the burnt ends, smoked chicken and ribs. For my sides I got Mac and cheese and baked beans. The burnt ends were very flavorful a and had a nice Smokey taste. Definitely regiment the burnt ends and ribs the chicken was decent. The baked beans were good and Mac was decent. Overall good bbq had been craving it for weeks and I was satisfied!!

A friend told us we needed to come here for hummus, so we listened and he was right. 

We started with both falafel and hummus. Both were amazing. The hummus was fresh and delicious. I wanted to order another, but we had more food coming. 

For entrees we got the chicken schwarma wrap and the lamb gyro with sides of fattoush and tabbouleh. I always prefer lamb and thought the pita would be better, but let me tell you, the chicken schwarma was out of this world. The lamb gyro was also very good though. 

Fattoush is always one of my favorite sides to get and I really liked it here. Tabbouleh is hit or miss for me and this one wasn't my favorite. There was a lot of lemon which I think made the parsley flavor even stronger than I'm used to (again, I'm not always the biggest fan of it in general, so you may love it). 

As far as sides go, the fries that our friend got may have been my favorite. The were the twice fried, crispy, flavorful kind that I love. 

The service was friendly but pretty slow. We were the only ones in the restaurant and it took a long time to get our food. It wasn't a big deal for us, but it could be an issue if you're trying to come for lunch while working. 

I'm definitely looking forward to coming back for more hummus and chicken schwarma.
Very disappointed. The rice for the bento box was very dry, the miso soup had a funky taste and the chicken teriyaki definitely did not taste anything like teriyaki sauce.

Ordered one of their signature burgers with Cajun fries to go. The Gold to be exact for $20. 
First thing. I asked about ketchup when the server Riley brought out my burger. 
She smirked and walked away and never returned. There was only 1 ketchup packet in the bag. I had to ask the bar tender for more ketchup and mustard. 
Ok whatever I guess....
When I get to the office to eat. I open the lid and there's 2 tiny pieces of bacon that looks like they were cooked to death several times over. The bun is smaller than a Mcdonalds cheeseburger bun yet supposed to fit a half pound patty. 
The menu description says the patty is prime rib chuck brisket and short-rib. I call BS. The patty was a very bland tasting medium rare meat. The meat was exactly the same mass produced extremely lean flavorless patty that any casino serves in their coffee shop for 8.95. 
I'm a burger connoisseur. I've tried almost every specialty burger place in Reno and Carson City. 
I have tried the ground beef types from most of the larger markets in the area as well (Raleys, Savemart, Smiths, Walmart, Costco and from a local ranch in Pleasant Valley) in my own homemade burgers. I KNOW what ground meat with chuck and prime rib taste like and that wasn't it.  Total bill with tip was $25. I would not go back. I gave them 2 stars because the Cajun fries were good.

Sure enough they charged me $4 over what I specified for the tip.

I have been here twice now and waited to review it to make sure my experiences warranted a review,  either good or bad. Let me start by explaining that my husband and I have developed a 3-strike policy over the years after many, many poor dining experiences. This restaurant has struck-out after our second visit. Our first visit we tried one of the philly cheesestakes and a pizza, along with a side of tots. Both dishes had jalapenos and although incredibly spicy, tasted good. The pizza, however, was swimming in grease. Between the spice and the grease, one slice sent my stomach into spasms, and I am a spice connoisseur. The tots were the highlight as lightly deep-fried potato confections from heaven. Sadly with the pizza not setting well I wasn't able to continue indulging on the tots. 

Our second visit we once again ordered tots and decided to try burgers and another starter, the bread bites with marinara. The tots were once again the highlight and the bread bites a close second. They were bites of lightly crisped pizza dough topped with butter and parmesan exterior, with a soft, chewy interior. Some were a bit extra-chewy on the edges, but none were beyond edibility. 

Our burgers, however, were a huge letdown. I ordered the Jack of All Trades with 1/4 lb. patty, bacon, avocado, jack cheese and chipotle mayo. When it arrived I couldn't believe the size of the patty. I know 1/4 isn't huge, but this was tiny and cooked til it was hard and dry. The cheese had bubbles over the

Del Frisco's offers a great patio during pandemic era dining. Most recently we went for lunch on a Sunday, and had the crab cake appetizer, beyond burger with fries, and steak sandwich with fries. They served normal-sized fries which was sad (we loved their skinny fries) but they were still tasty. They were following all social distancing protocols and the service was excellent. Thankful to have this as an option right now!

My husband and I stopped in here on a walk after a terrible weather day.  We were greeted with a smile and welcomed.  The beer selection was great and the server Mateo made us feel welcome.  We happily made a reservation a few days from this visit to give us an opportunity to explore the menu in total.  Looking forward to our dinner in a few days!

The food was absolutely delicious. If you are looking for a great breakfast/brunch spot it is amazing. Ask for Ashley B, she has an infectious personality and makes the best suggestions. They make their own bacon infused vodka!
Food is fantastic and the portions are large.  The service is always good also.  A great addition to the neighborhood!

Good solid substantial breakfast, I've missed you so.  My wife and I had two Get Up and Go breakfasts for the first time in a very long time. Everything was naturally coked to order.

We did takeout. Unlike what it said on the Yelp info, they also have covered, outside dining to provide distancing.

This staple establishment in west Fishers is still where the locals eat.
Food is good pub grub fair. Beer selections are vast and solid. I enjoy coming here for happy hour and just hanging with friends. Pretty solid go to if you are in the area.
Delicious food, great service! My waitress was Tammy and she is super sweet. The food was great and fast! Will definitely come back!

I was pleasantly surprised by this ramen place. I'm usually not into the ramen hype because I always get disappointed. This is probably the best ramen place I've tried so far in Philly. 

It is located in the heart of Chinatown. It is a small but cozy place. There's always a lot of people so wait time can vary. It's probably easier if you have 2 people in your party. You have to have all people present in your party before they'll seat you. 

I ordered miso ramen which is $9 for a small bowel and $11 for a large bowel. The small was plenty and filling. It comes with an egg and pork belly. The soup to ramen ratio was perfect. The soup was a little too salty which is to be expected for ramen. But it's comfort food on a cold, winter day. 

I will definitely be back. It's way better than that Americanized bullshit ramen Cheu in Fishtown.

I literally dream about the kimchi fries. So so so good. I've brought in a few of my friends to experience this place as I'm not sure why it's not constantly busy. Great staff, great food, good prices. What's not to love?
I've ate here several times. Food and service have always been pretty decent....maybe not 5 star great but overall pretty good.

Reason for one star slow service and I mean really slow. Took them 10 minutes to take my order plus another 15 to give my coffee! Waited way too long for a simple coffee! It happen to me before but I decided to give them another chance. Never coming back again!

Great selection and quality of food, and I liked the option to order some thai food and sushi because those make for great shareable meals. We got 2 thai dishes, 3 regular rolls, and 1 special roll which was a ton of great food for 6 people.

It was pretty quick to do a takeout order, but I would have preferred an online ordering which they don't seem to have (phone only) and their happy hour specials are dine-in only (which is not specified on the site). The food had large portions and tasted great but was a little more pricey than other places, but I'd say that balances out to being worth it.
Great family owned spot with authentic Mexican food! Great service locks in the deal. If they were closer to Sparks I'd be here daily as their prices are very affordable

Came here in the midst of the virus heightened awareness environment. All things considered we only waited about ten minutes to get seated for a table of 2 on a Wednesday morning. Our waiter was friendly, efficient, and our food came out quickly as well. While we waited for the grub, the coffee was delicious, and they were quick to top us off as needed. The highlights of the meal: peach cobbler pancakes-- I've never had peaches in my pancakes but these were delicious, I don't think the peaches were fresh, but the dish itself was fantastic. The sausage that came with the pancakes was extremely hearty, and I've never had sausage like it--It was really enjoyable. The prices were average, to slightly higher than average, but again, the experience justified the cost. Would definitely return!

Went here for Sunday football and literally had to ask for the Colts game to be put on...the first bartender could have cared less then we asked another and it was over 5 min into the first quarter! Some of the other games weren't on either (Packer game was on small screen in the back) which is why we're there intitially.  So we left rather than stay and complain because there are so many other options downtown to watch NFL Sunday ticket...places where they take it serious.

I'll have seconds! A friend brought us to this spot after raving about the great lengua tacos and they certainly did not disappoint! 

The exterior is pretty unassuming and definitely has the "hole in the wall" vibe and you know, those places always have the best food. Inside, we were quickly greeted warmly and seated. There was a DJ playing some Spanish music and 80s classic rock (a bit of a weird combo but I like both genres). 

I had a sip of the horchata and damn was that tasty. I might have to indulge in one of my own next time! 

After having a crisis trying to decide between tacos, enchiladas or chilaquiles, I finally decided that I would try some tacos and ordered the lengua, chorizo and al pastor. I loved them all! I definitely would recommend all three again. Also, the corn tortillas were excelente! 

I can't wait to come back and try the rest of the menu, but it'll definitely be hard  to not just order the same thing again. Seriously, this might be one of those places that I just never move on from my first impression dishes because those tacos are just that good.
The food is amazing and the staff is very friendly. I m coming back to try other plates.

I lived in Houston for six nightmarish years. But this isn't the time or place to get into that. I will say this. During that nightmare of unspeakable horror, I developed a taste for Tex-Mex cuisine. Senor Salsa delivers the goods, y'all.

We love this place so much, we returned three times in one month. I am so obsessed with their jumbo shrimp tacos and that special orange sauce they serve on the side, I order it every time. (And between visits to Senor Salsa, I find myself dreaming about those shrimp tacos. I almost crashed my car once, imagining a long romantic walk on the beach with my beloved shrimp tacos. ((What's in that orange sauce, anyway? Paradise. And maybe crack.)))

Our last visit was on a Sunday night. The place was packed, yet we were seated promptly and the food came lighting fast! I don't know how they do it, but the service is consistently excellent and the quality food tastes fresh and well-prepared and the prices are reasonable.

I wish I could comment on the other dishes but I only have eyes for those shrimp tacos. Mmmm. So good. I'm drooling on my phone as I write.

One warning. There's a spot in the restaurant center right with strange red lighting that casts a crimson hue over your food. Don't sit here if you like to ogle your food and revel in its glorious true colors.
I have only tried the American Honey...and it is delish. It is one of the best pizzas I have ever had. I like the size of the pizza. The flavor is just right!
We enjoyed all of our dishes and drinks. Sitting at the patio was awesome and our waitress was very efficient. We will definitely come back in the future .

Tried out the Mosaic On a Friday night. Was seated right away. Waited about 20 minutes and two bowls of chips to get our order in. There were a total of 5 people seated including our table. It took over an hour to get food. The food was tasteless and the tortillas were terrible. We were given plastic silverware when we were dining in snd were not able to order any desert. I get the covid thing but the Mosaic is k own for great tortillas. Won't go to the one on La Cholla for awhile. Very sad. The two waiters tried but the food was just bad.

On June 1st I visited for the first time for dinner and the staff was very helpful. There were things on the menu that I didn't understand and I was very indecisive, but one of the cooks, I think he was a manager, he was very helpful in explaining the menu to me. Needless to say, my visit was pleasant and I will be coming back.

I ordered chicken shish kabob, Half house salad, half rice with side of garlic sauce and pita bread. It was not only healthy, but so delicious. The chicken was so tender and flavorful, the salad was fresh and tasty, the rice was pretty good, but the garlic sauce was  super addicting, I kept dipping my naan bread in it. I am hooked and look forward to trying other dishes.  Whatever I decided to order next time, I think I'll get  a side of fries to dip in the garlic sauce.
Great service and nice place to get food! Cool vibe when u walk in and super friendly staff def would recommend for a place when ur craving some food Indian food!
It looks like a hole in the wall but the servers are amazing just the vegan option is only one but it was good the home fries were way too thin

I ordered a curbside pick up so I could grab it on my way to work. The order was for 8:15 pm on a Friday night. I got there at 8:18 and text them I was here, I waited about 10 mins then decided to call them since I needed to go because I needed to get to work. I got a hold of someone and they were able to bring it out soon after she handed me the bag of food and she turned around and went back inside and I left because I had to hurry to get to work on time. When I sat to have lunch I realized there were no utensils and I specifically put I needed utensils and there are no utensils at my work so I had to eat my steak and bowl of chili with my hands...on top of that I had part of some other customers order and about 5 fries with my steak...I wasn't very happy at all. The last time I ordered something from this Chili's was on Christmas Eve I did curbside then too and then I got a call from the restaurant on my way there that they had already closed even though the website let me order and pay for that specific pick up time... and it took almost 2 weeks to get my money refunded to me...so I think I'm done with Chili's and I will be taking my business elsewhere.

Greetings! I want to say that everything was spectacular when I ordered online and drove to the restaurant. My order number was: 541169302. I visited on April 8, 2020.

When I arrived at the restaurant curb side parking stall, Abbey or Ashley (I can't recall her name) was very pleased that she came out without me having to call the number on the sign in front of the parking stall. Great!! She was very personable, smiled, and had her gloves on too! Hooray for social distancing!! After she verified who I was, she walked back in, retrieved my order in "short order" (I meant to do that), returned to my car. I told her how impressed I was with my initial visit today. She smiled and I handed her an additional $5 in tips because of the level of service I received. Only one problem. When I got home, only one of my sandwiches came without mayonnaise as both were ordered without. Good-bye fifth star.

Two weeks prior to today, I placed an order online and when I had arrived at the restaurant only to find out that my order was not ready. I waited an additional 20 minutes past the time that I requested for it to be ready. Today's visit was a far cry from my visit two weeks ago. You have not lost a customer, but I hope that things get better. I would like nothing more than to give you a five-star rating next time.

Lastly, I want to thank Abbey/Ashley for such a great greeting and magnificent service.

Anthony

Thai food is the best after a long cold day. Social distancing is enforced and the food was alright, but there were some concerns. 

The service was not the best because there was only one person (so we were understanding) but two tables that sat down way after us got their food and drinks before us so that was frustrating. Our food was kind of cold and the chicken was a bit rubbery. The curry puff appetizers were dry, but with good flavor. 

I'm giving it 3 stars because the flavors never really disappoint, but I've had better experiences with service and overall portion sizes.

This place has plenty of slice options and a good menu. I recommend the pizza turnovers, they are big sizes and very tasy. I have been here three times now and have liked the pizza, sandwiches, and turnovers.

Normally I like this place but I called to see if they had curbside delivery and the response from the lady on the phone was mediocre. She said yeah and then she asked if I wanted a side and she said "ugh" and then proceeded to put me on hold and left me on hold for good. Sorry for trying to support your business.

Visiting from out of state and heard great things about this place.  I was very excited to try it out.  To my disappointment, it did not live up to the hype.  The nirvana martini was weak.  I ordered the spicy bourbon wings.  There was no spice to them.  In fact my friends ordered the georgia peach and the honey bourbon wings and they all tasted the same.  I also ordered the steak pineapple bowl which was completely void of any seasoning.  Lastly the service was horrendous.  It was a busy night and i get that.  We asked for things that we never even got.  The ONLY bright spot was the music.  I would never come back.  Disappointed.

Great boba with perfect chewy texture, sweetness from brown sugar syrup, and a hint of herbal taste. The original milk tea like Oolong and black tea are the most flavorful in the menu. The milk cap is pretty outstanding with sweet milk tea and a creamy, salty white foam on top. The tea quality they were using was considerably a good one. Free wifi is a plus.
We've been missing a great place to find BBQ for over 10 years. There are few in the city but we were stoked to find one local! The ribs and wings are amazing. We'll be going back for more!

I've wanted to try this place for the longest time as I am a soup fanatic, however after trying I am surprised at all the five star reviews. First off the environment is great and hip. Trendy music and very clean. The workers (I'm assuming the owners as it was a husband wife duo) were friendly enough and seemed to care about my order. 

I order half of a grilled cheese and tomato basil soup as well as a sugar cookie. It was together $10, so not terrible. However, some critiques. 
-The grilled cheese was ok, not outstanding. It was unfortunately not dippable into my tomato soup because it did not soak up any soup, maybe the grease I'm not sure. 
-you are not given any plate or tray to eat on, so your sandwich and soup you are eating on the bare tables. This may not be bad for some but for me it was a bit odd.
-the tomato soup was good, but I could get the same quality in a can.
Overall you can definitely tell this is a family run business. They seem to care about their restaurant but havent worked out all the exact kinks yet. Not sure again why there are so many reviews raving about this place, it was pretty mediocre in my opinion.
Amazing place..... very nice ambiance on the patio, tea room is wonderful.... the place has some history.  Service was top notch and the cheeseburger delicious..... this place is a St Pete gem

This Location Gets an EASY 5 Star review if I could have given it more I'd of done just that! I visited this location yesterday around 3/4pm from start to finish it was hands down a great experience. I've always frequent this location and it's always great service fresh hot food and very clean seating areas! I'd like to give a speacial shout out to my sever Chelsea she was the best! I mean I didn't have to ask it was like she was reading my mind on what I needed before I could say anything! Also the manager Tia was great! She came over to chat with me about my food and handle it was such warmth and understanding including satisfying my needs! Also informing me that they will start delivering to my area soon! Thank you for such a great time! Keep up the GREAT work!
Best bread in Reno!!! Located in a small strip mall, this was a great find for me. Sourdough bread is bliss. So is the Jalapeño bread.
Always happy to support this place. They've been really on top of orders and do a good, safe job of controlling the crowd

Came here for a 630 Sunday dinner with my husband and suburban parents. I was a little nervous when I saw the 3.5 stars on yelp and a practically empty restaurant, but we all loved our meals and were very impressed with the dining experience (including my picky gluten free mother)

Don't let the negative reviews turn you away! Most complaints on here seem to be about restaurant week (never have I ever been impressed with a restaurant week experience...  I still refuse to go back to Abe Fishers)

Yes, the menu is very limited and the Sunday Supper pre-Fixe menu is set in stone with no substitutions, but the fewer the options=the better they perfect each dish. Check out the menu online before you go!

I ordered the Mushroom Ravioli and Arctic Char, combined it was a filling amount of food and both were prepared perfectly. The rest of the table had ordered the Striped Bass, Beet Gazpacho, Braised Lamb, Pork Sausage, and Fettucini Bolognese. You could clearly tell the fresh ingredients and culinary precision that went into each dish. Service was very friendly and attentive. We enjoyed ourselves and would definitely recommend. I do think this place is easy to miss unless you know about it, but having the dining room to ourselves felt very VIP and I wouldn't mind that experience again.

Stopped at this location last night. Arrived at the front door around 9:00pm only to find out the doors were locked. There were still customers inside the dining room eating! One of the customers inside was kind enough to come and open the doors for us. When we got into the lobby we were told the dining room was closed, we were quickly ushered out and the doors were locked behind us. Last time I checked most places don't lock the doors with customers still inside?? What steak n shake closes at 9:00? What a joke! We will not be returning to this location. How can this chain still exist? if you can't properly operate the restaurant you should just board it up and shut it down.

WHY ON EARTH is this place closed?????!!??? I'm so disappointed. We are a vegan family that frequented here once a month for a family lunch and now there's a new place here (that's non vegetarian). We are so disappointed.
Food was absolutely delicious! However, it took a long time to get food and I got my food after everyone else was almost done with theirs. So for that reason I only gave it 4/5
the food was fantastic, staff was so sweet, and was an all around great experience. they even gave us free ice cream at the end of our meal!

Most experiences I've had with this place are bad. Employees are rude, ignore customers and just talk to eachother. There were only 5 cars in line tonight and we sat there for 30 minutes. Typical for 10th street fast food though. The 30 minute thing here is normal though. Even when theres barely anyone in line. The food is usually fine but tonight in particular everything was dry. Like if you take that long you'd at least expect it to be hot like goddamn. Idk I gotta start going to another one

Farewell, Joanie. A friend organized a party at your Pizzeria, so we all could say good-bye. I had never been, so it was a first and last time for me. 

Being on a diet, I didn't order pizza. I enjoyed a Caesar Salad and their house made dressing was top notch. I also had an order of Buffalo Wings, that was a special that evening. For pizzeria wings, they were pretty tasty. 

Our server was accommodating and friendly. She said business had jumped up drastically, since the closure announcement. However, it's still too late to save the business.  

It's sad to see a local business close, especially one who had been open as long as Joanie's. However, from my one visit, I could tell it hadn't changed much since it's opening and perhaps that was the downfall. 

When: February 5, 2020
Why: Announced Closing

I frequent this location as my child loves broccoli and cheddar soup but for review I am eating the food I ordered as well as the delivery experience. I ordered Panera to the hospital where I work. The driver was extremely pleasant and was able to make it all the way up to my work station so I give him props for that. Food delivery drivers typically have a hard time navigating through the hospital and end up calling me to meet them downstairs so this was pretty refreshing. I ordered one of the new warm grain bowls. Flavor was pretty good, portion size also was impressive. My only gripe was the container that my food was in was slimy on the outside. So as soon as I reached in to grab my bowl, my hands were already dirty. This was also a little annoying because my bread was just tossed in the bag as well so it absorbed a little of what I assume (and hope) was tomato goo. A little attention to detail goes a long way especially when it comes to cleanliness.. but the bowl itself tasted great and was filling.
Cute little breakfast spot! The food reminds me of home  and is very comforting. Nothing really stood out to me, but prices are fair.

Wow, what an amazing experience. I came here for downtown dining week just before all the major shutdowns. We were seated promptly and our coats were checked. The atmosphere was posh with white linen table cloths and napkins. The hostess, server and (I can only assume) the manager were all very polite, warm and accommodating. We had a lovely 2 course meal with complementary sparkling water. The soup was a roasted tomato soup with a cream topping. So delicious, I would have licked the plate if it wasn't such a swanky place. And the pasta was just scrumptious. Mushrooms, chicken and black truffle in a cream sauce. There were many sighs of contentment during this meal. The literal cherry on top at the end was a delicious complementary chocolate covered cherry, obviously makdein house. Stellar service and exceptional food. I can't wait until we can dine in house again.

Pls be Careful about how they charge you for your order!!!!   THAI PHOOKET II CHARGE YOU A 15% SERVICE CHARGE for a TOGO ORDER!!!!
This is ridiculous!!!!   I think it's very unethical especially when u don't provide any special service to receive this tips.  Usually I will leave them some tips but 15% is a little bit too much for a TOGO order.

This is my go-to place when I want something to eat when I'm in St. Louis. Fast, fresh, healthy, and affordable. I'm a fan of the ahi tuna poke bowl, and the holy shiitake roll and bowl. I'm sure I'll like just about anything there, but I've loved these two so much that I haven't gotten myself to try anything else...yet. And, oh yeah, the wonton chips are addictive.

IF YA THINKING ABOUT COMING HERE BC NEYOWS IS PACKED DONT LMAOOOOO. I would not recommend coming to this place at all. The wait for food was 45 minutes & no one was in the establishment. We would ask the so called manager what the waiting time was & she had nothing to say. One of my friends ordered a burger & she waited for an hour before she received her food. They said that the burgers are thick so it take awhile to cook. I don't know about you but an hour is uncalled for. When she got the burger it was thin & not thick at all. So if you want long wait times & an incompetent manager I def recommend you coming here.

This is the worst experience I've ever had at a sub shop. With six people working it took 20 min to get our food..I had orderd a roast beef sandwich with mustard mayo and peppers. That is it.They got it wrong so I returned the sandwich..another 15 min go by and still no sandwich..finally after asking the extremely RUDE cashier about it..she asks the other employees if they've re made it yet...NO they have not !!! At this point I'm done !! All I want is my money back and after bieng as rude as a someone can get the manager finally gives me money back !!!
Thanks for ruining lunch with my daughter. 
Gaurntee you I'll be going somewhere else in the future!!
The time stamp on my receipt says it all..way too long to wait for one sandwich to be made.

While you hear the phrase "family owned and operated" all the time, Christo's Restaurant is truly such. Upon arriving, we mentioned that we had never been here before. Within minutes, both brothers, whose father owns it, came over and introduced themselves. One is the chef while the other is I assumed to be the front end manager.
Our server has worked there over 11 years....and that also speaks volumes. He explained the specials and the menu.
My wife had a sesame seed chicken stir fry special and I had chicken parmigiana. Meals came with soup or salad, warm rolls plus dessert. The food was prepared fresh. The Chef also took time to explain and showed us their fresh fish selections. I love tuna, and was told that if it's not on the menu, just ask! This restaurant is clean, friendly, inviting and definitely worth many return visits. It's children friendly as well, with a colorful kids menu.
When people enjoy what they do, it shows.....and this restaurant is definitely a keeper.

Wonder if original owner is gone or something seems like people who works there don't care anymore , aguas frescas seems made out of packets with extra sugar on it , Tortas are ok , the pozole seems like somebody else beside a Mexican cook and serve it , front help not as friendly , has been twice that we ask for cups and didn't get one , last time for me
This place was good! I think its a cool spot if you want a couple of drinks and some light fare. They have a lot of cool sandwiches and crepes! I had the brie BLT which was good!

I ordered number 71 from their menu but sadly I've eaten here since they have open but this time the chicken that was also served in this dish was very dry and old. You could taste a sour taste in the chicken. It's so dry that it crumbled up in my mouth making me take a big gulp of my drink. I've never been so disappointed with my meal at this place. I feel sick and I couldn't complete my food. The rice was dry and the Pork that was served with the food was very dry too. All around this dish is not good I had maybe 6 scoops with my spoon till I had both the chicken and pork inside my mouth that's when I couldn't think of anything but reach for my drink of water... now let's talk about the water. The water smells like pool water and you could taste that the water came from the sink.. I live in the Area and I know how the water taste. I'm very disappointed with the food. The table next to mine had some kid using his straw and shooting spit balls! For real what type of stuff is that? It's a restaurant not your damn home keep that shit there! Stay away from here! There's many other options in the area. Don't be fooled, just because it's new or whatever the food isn't worth your money or time.

You have a wonderful decorator but...Everything is way to SALTY! I mean hypertension dangerously salty. Cheap rebates cuts of meat smothered in MSG is far from authentic Mexican food. Poblano peppers stuffed with mozzarella cheese and Cuban black beans is not authentic.
Just for health reasons you need to get a new cook

I really wanted to like this place and had higher than average expectations for it because of the great reviews and getting written up in several food articles for NOLA. 

Unfortunately, I was not impressed. I suppose it's because I have access to authentic Vietnamese food in the Bay Area, especially San Jose. The food is decent, just not extraordinary. The service is pretty abrupt and the restaurant is very cold. It feels a little tired and could use brighter light. 

The bakery next door offers a ton of different fresh pastries, bread, Vietnamese sweets, and banh mi sandwiches, which are made fresh and actually look really good. 

Location is pretty far out from downtown/French Quarter.

Updated Review!!!!
Aug 25,2019 @ 349 pm 
I came back for a second time because the first time was such a great experience. However today I was turned away. The cashier stated that she was unable to talk anymore walk in orders. I am very disappointed because this order was for a family member who didn't have the means of transportation to get to this area. I had spoke such high reviews about this place that they wanted to try it for themselves. Hopefully in the future they will not turn down business because it isn't a good look.


------------------------------------------------





As soon as I walked in I was greeted with a friendly smile. I placed my order and within 10
Mins my food was delivered to me. Within my wait I watched tv and had casual
Conversation with the host. Great experience and Iwill be back
Love this place I die for their million dollar bacon. Service is always great and they listen well to the customers. It also feels very homey.
Extremely delicious, delicate and aesthetically pleasing food plating, and great service. Five stars+

The pizza at Vetri was good but nothing to write home about. No qualms, it just reminded me of every other specialty pizza place I've been to. The restaurant itself is tucked away in a side street, and we were able to get seated right away for dinner on a Wednesday. Perhaps I was just expecting more from the Vetri name, but still a solid meal.

We love this place.  We live in St Charles and drive over here all the time.  Drinks are cold and strong.  Food is amazing!  Waitresses are nice and are on it!!  Great service always!  Highly recommend!!!

We have eaten here twice for the lunch buffet. It will be hard for us to choose to go here at other times when the restaurant is not serving the buffet. The buffet they offer has very delicious choices and the offerings are slightly different each day. I have yet to find anything on the buffet that I didn't like. The staff is very nice but not overly aggressive with interrupting you while you eat. Today the cream cheese wontons were absolutely delicious as well as the Tom Yum soup. The atmosphere is a very pleasant light jazz music background. The chairs are classy and comfortable. The best thing about the buffet is the price! Very reasonable. You will not be disappointed. Give this place a try!
Best fried shrimp anywhere I know of. Have been going for years, and whenever I'm back in the Philadelphia area, this os a must stop at place.
Food and service is amazing every time we go. I got a shrimp pasta last time and almost licked the bowl clean! Love the atmosphere here and try the pizza its so good!

My family and I are in Nashville on vacation and we're in the mood for some Japanese/Thai food. We decided to carry out and eat at our hotel and when we got back and started to eat, the tuna that topped two of the rolls was bad and tasted really off. After trying all of the food we quickly realized that everything we ordered was off. The food ended up making my mom sick. Would not recommend at all.

We are here at Circles, sitting at the Tiki bar, the food and drinks are very good, there is as DJ or I think there is. We can't hear the music, the age of the patrons is 30- 60. Play genre appropriate and loud enough to be heard. Forget the Techno stuff.

I have ordered here for a family of 3 a few times a month to go or for rapid pick up.  Every single time the order is incorrect and we have NO unique requests or customizations. Most frustrating was tonight during covid crisis. Our orde for 3 was once again incorrect- u pick 2 order only included one of two items. When we got home and realized we were missing one of our meals, we tried to call immediately. We called over 10 times with no answer at 645 pm. I then went to store for refund of item or to get item and also gracious tip. After waiting outside and knocking, I was told they close at 7pm. No notification on doors or phone. No way to get good item replaced. No apology. Why would a restaurant close at 7 but take orders at 645. With no rush, why wasn't order checked?  So frustrating but like I said, this location never gets it right.
Lunch was prompt and a good value.  We had the chicken fajitas.  Very tasty and served hot.
Ate here today. With my husband.  We are vegetarian and enjoyed the variety of food.  Excellent service as well. Preston was an attentive server

I can see why this place is so popular. The biscuits: 
They are so fresh and fluffy that it is worth waiting an hour to have brunch. The line apparently starts by 8 on weekends . 
You order at the register then someone delivers your food to your table.  
We had biscuits with gravy and Nashville fried chicken. Too die for!

Overpriced and food is not that good. Tourist trap. 
Older Woman was rude and acted like it was an inconvenience that we were even there.

This is the sorriest excuse for what Popeye's was at one time!  We chose the fried fish combo and it was a disgusting example of over fried tasteless food ever!  The fish was fried to the point of being fragile!  I picked up a piece and it and the fried broke when I tried to bite !  The sweet tea a tasteless tan water!  Left the food here n the trash....   not even good enough to feed the dogs a treat!


WHAT HAPpENED to POPEYES????   Not my idea of "food"!!!!   The commercials are a joke!!!!!!!  Been a while since we tried but they will not ever see me again!


Here is what the staff did as we were leaving!  Walked to the window facing our car in the handicap spot and laughed and waved til we left the parking lot!  One black employee and two Hispanic girls!!!  Not many manors in their upbringing!  Race or color has no bearing on this...  mentioned only so hq knows who was on duty at 610pm on 15 August!  It isn't just your food that needs amending!  I do not care if you are stripped and polka dotted!  You belong to the human race and you owe some respect!   Really saddened at the experience!
Lesson learned!!!!!!
Holy Moly!  This is an *experience*, like going to Disney or something!   Beyond gorgeous. Love the theming and decor.  Super packed, so make a reservation.  The food was divine!!!

Having tried to eat here a few weeks ago and not having a reservation, we made reservations for a Friday night.  The ambience is more formal, meaning linen table cloths and napkins, but the clientele was anything but when we were there at 7 pm.  Nor was the wait staff "stuffy", in fact we had fun chatting with each of them, and the chef  delivering each course was very responsive.  Our booth by the street window gave us the best of both inside and outside people watching.

They had Berry Rose Cider on tap - the only cider and it was delicious.  Perfect for a hot evening.  Our Calamari appetizer was one of the yummiest, soft on the inside and crispy with a dusting of fresh Parmesan on the outside.  They were sliced calamari steaks rather than tentacles, and it was a pleasant surprise.

Hub ordered New York steak from the Fixe Pris menu and the table-side salad bar and huckleberry cobbler came with it.  All was nicely prepared, delicious and delivered by a chef who answered questions we had.

I ordered the Wild Prawns and scallops.  The seafood tasted great, but I was surprised that they advertised the scallops as wrapped in prosciutto. It was wrapped in barely cooked bacon slices, and as the bacon wasn't cooked very well, it was nigh on impossible to eat.  Other than that glitch, everything was delicious.

We'll return as its a nice destination to enjoy with friends and/or for a special occasion.

The best wings around! Get them with Frankensauce it's the best! Also the fries come with this special buffalo, garlic Parmesan sauce it's addicting. All of their food is great but these stand out the most! The blue cheese is so good, I think it's made from scratch by them! They also have such a large selection of beer from all over the world!

I have never been to a more filthy McDonald's in my life. I walked into the bathroom stall the toilet lid was up and it looked like it had never been cleaned. There was feces on the floor and paper. There is no way I would except food from this location.

Such a fun 70's themed bar/diner. There's two levels, although I think the second is closed because of COVID. They've got (socially distanced) live music and a great patio. I went on a Saturday and the music was fantastic! The food was amazing, I had a California Chicken Sandwich - so good.

I've only dined here a few times, but I wish I had the opportunity for a few more times. Read that this restaurant is closing, which is unfortunate. The restaurant had a great atmosphere and delicious food. All the best to Chef Chris Ponte as he pursues other restaurant ventures in the area. I look forward to visiting those soon.

Well this is certainly a "don't judge a book by it's cover" type of place. My boyfriend wanted a nice steak dinner for his birthday and I let him choose the spot this time. When we pulled up to a Motel, to say that I was a bit floored was an understatement but I kept my mouth shut because it was his birthday pick. Up until we got through the front door, I wasn't convinced. However, as soon as we stepped through the door, I was thrilled. 

You walk in and it's like you've gone back in time to sounds of Frank Sinatra, a tasteful mirrored wall and a bartender in a vest. It was a welcome surprise for sure. The hostess was not present when we first walked in but the bartender was willing to seat us and was extremely pleasant. We were seated in a back corner that was intimate and perfect. 

On to the food! The warm bread and rosemary, garlic butter was literally out of this world. We ordered calamari to start and I wish we went with the mussels. The breading on the calamari was bland but they were warm, as was the marinara. I ordered the crab scampi and the portion size was a bit small (perhaps it was so good I just wanted more) but the quantity and quality of crab was the best that I've ever had. It was not shredded up and hidden in the sauce. They were true jumbo chunks that were delicious. 

My bf had the surf and turf with the garlic topping and the bacon jam on the side. The steak was perfectly medium rare, seared to perfection. The bacon jam was the most unique thing I've eve

Yummy food but very unfortunate that they're extremely understaffed and unmanaged. Good food like I said, but you will be there for a while. The staffing makes no sense they say to seat yourself but the waiters/waitresses do not understand. Overheard the kitchen say that the kitchen is backed up and can no longer put in orders..... the restaurant was at half capacity. I hope they can get a handle on it.

Everything seems to be high quality and my husband says everything is homemade. He has been here 3 times and loved it each time. They have a cool menu with great options. Def a place to go to if your wanting something new or a new twist to your fav foods.

Very limited menu.
Nice views, good service, but I was not very pleased with the food. I often have calamari appetizer as a meal at other places and when I attempted to do the same here it was a disaster.
Not much protein, really. It should be called calamari sweet slaw. It is awfully sweet (OK, my bad, that was in the name), and it had barely any calamari and lots of purple cabbage and carrots, with the sweet thick sauce. If I wanted a salad or vegetables I would have ordered that.
And what is the deal with the tiny coffee cups? Second mistake, I ordered a capuccino. So my tiny cup was half foam. Jeez, not a good day, I'm telling you.

Was recommended from a friend and What can I say the food was amazing. I had the blackened steak n jambalaya rice n mashed potatoes with a side of crab cake which was sooooo good.. definitely recommend the crab cakes. I would definitely come back again!

The best coconut soup (Tom Kha) ever.  The service has always been good, now with pick up they are always accommodating.  Food is fresh and very tasty.  Can be a bit too spicy.  I just request to be lite on the spice. They have never disappointed us with their dishes.

After a horrible experience at another Sullivan's Location, I spoke with their corporate operations group, and they requested that I give them another try. I will say that they took my complaints at the other location very seriously, and genuinely tried to resolve my issues. Based on the exchange, I agreed to give the location in King of Prussia a shot, since my experience at one of their other locations was poor.

Their manager, and our server were excellent. The atmosphere and quality of food was significantly better than what was experienced at the other location. Our waiter Michael was extremely attentive, and provided excellent service. The food was good as well. Given this company's effort to remedy a poor experience, and then following through on the promise to make up for our prior experience, I will definitely give them business again and go back to the King of Prussia location.

We went in on Sunday evening  around five.  No one came to check on us at least 15 or 20 min.  Finally, a waitress came to take our order.  The wait for the food was over 30 min.  No one checked on us during that time.  Food finally came.  The food was good.  We wanted to tell the manager about the service.  Even before we could explain what went wrong, he said, "I know, I know."  His attitude was totally not acceptable as a manager....no wonder.....

The only thing good in my dinner was the flan. The shrimp with yellow rice was so salty that I wonder whether the chef just dumped an entire bottle of salt there. It was not edible at all! Delta terminal definitely needs a better restaurant than this one. Unfortunately, Columbia Restaurant was the only sit down place in Delta terminal.

I just walked out of there and I have never had ruder service. The blond girl that was at the counter couldn't be more uninterested in helping me. I asked her opinion on a Thai Chicken Noodle, and her response in a a monotone voice' "yeah it's good." Checking me out. She just slides the food over and walks away. No thank you, no eye contact. I asked for a receipt and no response. Just puts the receipt in the bag and walks away.

One of the best places I've eaten in Tampa. Super fresh food, fast service. Will 100% be back. Fresh bakery is super cute with a lot of options. The decor and ambiance makes me think I'm not in Tampa !!

At Seis, every day is taco Tuesday! Seis out of five stars!

It's a crime to eat Mexican food without drinks so I did the right thing by having the house margarita and bloody mary. The marg was a little too sweet but the bloody mary was on point! It was a powerful and perfect blend of spicy and sweet. Oh, and the salt. Yeah, I would have licked it all if it was socially acceptable. Note: the bloody mary is stronger than the margarita.

Their street tacos are more refined than what you would find at your typical food truck. The calabacitas are a great vegan option. The zucchini and squash were perfectly sautéed and the avocado was creamy. The tortillas were a little stale but I've been here enough times to know they are usually just right.

It goes against conventional wisdom, but try mixing the medium and mild spiced salsa. This way the spice from the salsa verde is slightly diluted and you get a subtle smoky flavor from the mild salsa. It's a winning combo. Just trust me.

Elite tip: happy hour M-F 3-6pm.
I can't believe the flavors and tastiness of this!! I will recommend this place any time someone asks. Thank you for such a great experience.

Ordered online and drove to the restaurant to pick up the food. They have a pretty simple process for food pickup to reduce the exposure to others during this time. They send you a text, you respond with the parking spot number and your cars make/model. Their staff is friendly and efficient with your food pickup. The food on the other hand is average at best. My son was disappointed with his Macaroni burger (looks nothing like the picture on their website). I ordered the Jamaican Black Pepper Chicken and Shrimp. My dish was a good portion size, came with Rice, Black Beans, and Plantains for my sides. I would have liked a little more kick to the flavor or the dish, but overall I was happy with my food.

So good that I ate here twice in one week. The first time around I had a catfish poboy. When I tell you that bread was so soft and fresh. The catfish was tasty. I also had their bread pudding. It was so light and sweet. I LOVED it. Yesterday I ordered the crawfish pasta. Yet again another win! Their service is great. Both times I called and my order was promised within 15 minutes. I was already en route when I placed my order. When i arrived my food was ready and I did not have to wait. Barrows is a must!

So good! My husband and I came here this morning before work and got the pumpkin cheesecake muffin and a lemon cheesecake muffin as well as to bagel sandwiches. The muffins are so fresh and flavorful! They have so many different flavors it's so hard to choose just one! The Ranchero sandwich had the perfect amount of spice to it. I've been to just about every bagel joint in Reno and this one is now at the top of my list! Thank you my favorite muffin!!!

One of my COVID regular outings is a long bike ride with a couple of friends from Ventura to Carp. We usually go to Esau's for brunch and love it. Today it was packed, so we opted to go to Oaxaca Fresh instead. The tables were all outside under umbrellas and spaced far apart and into the street with barriers. The owner waited on us. The service was amazing, of course. The chips and salsas were fresh and delish. I ordered the Carne Asada platter. The entree arrived and the steak was marinated and cooked to perfection. The beans and rice were light and savory. Fresh avocado and sautéed peppers and onions topped the dish. Not too heavy, not smothered in cheese, not oily. It was SO GOOD. The tortillas were hot and a little crispy, and it was just a great meal. One of us got the carne asada burrito and that was also excellent. I will definitely be coming back to this place. I love that the owner took such pride in his food. It's GREAT!!!!

Ordered through GrubHub and I felt it would be hard to construe exactly what I wanted - which was 1/2 pineapple and then the other half pineapple, sausage, and garlic. The second half was without pineapple and it was so bland :/. Crust has no flavor and sausage is very seedy and again, rather flavorless. I usually order Dominos but my husband wanted wings - but I will be ordering Dominos next time.

I travel through the entire southeast for business and this Chick-fil-a has the slowest drive thru hands down.  It took 12 minutes to just get to order my meal and another 5 to actually get it.  Any Chick- fil-a in Georgia would have had me in and out in less than 5 min.  If you have a short lunch break do not go to this chick-fil-a

This is the first two-story IKEA I've ever visited. It is really neat. It's located not too far off of I-4, soon after you enter Tampa and it's not too difficult to find if you use your GPS. Huge parking lot.

The first time we arrived, we immediately went upstairs to get lunch. Then back downstairs to get a cart, then back upstairs via the elevator to walk around. (There are no carts on the second floor. You have to pick one up on the first floor. A bit odd, but understandable.)

The bathrooms are located right when you walk in behind the escalators downstairs and behind the cafe upstairs and are very large and clean.

We have a great time here. Thanks to the IKEA app on my phone and very knowledgeable employees, we are able to locate everything we were shopping for. WiFi is easily available throughout the entire building.

Ordered from Uber eats and spent $105 on seafood to throw in the trash. Oysters that were "steamed" arrived freezing cold and gooey in the center, shrimp and crab were mushy and cold and undercooked. Contacted the restaurant directly prior to posting a review, however I was told that it was an "Uber eats issue" and to contact them because we used a third party vendor! Insanity! Uber eats did not cook my food or lack thereof. Apparently this is a restaurant that does not stand behind their service. As a consumer I was dismissed and told that it wasn't their issue to deal with. Stay far away from this place. Absolutely blown away by the poor quality and above all horrendous customer service experience.
This place is amazing! The chicken was juicy and flavorful and the staff was so welcoming. I will come back at least 100 more times. Don't sleep on this place!!

Needed a drink before stopping by a liquor store. Didn't know they had a happy hour! Ordered a old fashion and a Moscow Mule and it was strong! (That's how I like it!) and they greet you while your entering onto the place! Which is very welcoming! After the old fashion was settling in, I needed something in my stomach so I ordered nachos. THESE ARE NOT YOUR ORDINARY NACHOS!!! Please do not accept a full blown nacho platter with the works! These nachos are LITERALLY some fancy French cheese (quite delicious) and pulled pork over tortilla chips! Super duper yummy! I added some more bbq sauce for more flavor! Over all, bartenders were friendly and super nice and drinks are affordable!

My wife and I last visited Outback a few years ago and had such a bad experience that we vowed to not return, but my wife is 8 months pregnant with twins and was craving steak. Covid + high risk twins + ice storm means I had to think out of the box this Valentine's Day. I decided to bite the bullet and try out Outback again. Opted for a scheduled delivery and hoped and prayed they cooked her steak right. 

Food arrived 5 minute before the estimate, boxed and bagged perfectly, and with all of the "extras" I requested if they were able. My wife's steak was spot on and fresh. Salads were delicious (I highly recommend the pecan and bleu cheese salad!!), and every single thing we asked for was there. Perfect order!

I'm blown away by this and will be ordering again sometime soon. Oh, and the blooming onion even came with reheat instructions! So clever. Major props to our delivery person, you were super sweet and we are thankful there are people willing to deliver right now. My very pregnant wife is so pleased. Happy Valentine's Day!
